simple.meaning: לֶתֶךְ (lethek) is a Hebrew word meaning “a measure for things dry.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H3963. lethek לֶ֫תֶךְ noun [masculine] a barley-measure (Late Hebrew id. , a corn-measure); only in וְל ׳חֹמֶרשְֿׂעֹרִים שְׂעֹרִים Hosea 3:2 ; according to ᵑ9 = 1/2 כֹּר = 1/2 חֹמֶר (q. v.), compare Mishna (Levy NHWB ii. 531 ), but this tradition is uncertain (compare Now Archaeology i. 203 ); ᵐ5 νέβελ οἴνου , for ׳ל ׳שׂ .
